License:  Only available in  TouchDesigner Pro .
The Clip  DAT  contains information about motion clips that are manipulated by a  Clip CHOP  and  Clip Blender CHOP .
The Clip  DAT  can hold any command or script text, which can be triggered based on the settings on the  Execute  parameter page (This is where the Clip  DAT  and the Text  DAT  are different). The Clip  DAT 's script is triggered by specified clips being played through a  Clip Blender CHOP .

parameters.label: Edit..
parameters.name: edit
parameters.description: Clicking this opens a text editor to add/edit/delete text from the  DAT .

parameters.label: File
parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The path and name of the file to load. Accepts .txt and .dat files. The file can be read in from disk or from the web. Use http:// when specifying a URL.

parameters.label: Reload File
parameters.name: reload
parameters.description: When set to 1, reloads the file into the  DAT .

parameters.label: Execute from
parameters.name: executeloc
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines the location the script is run from.

parameters.label: Current  Node
parameters.name: current
parameters.description: The script is executed from the current node location.

parameters.label: This  Node
parameters.name: here
parameters.description: The script is executed from the Text  DAT  itself.

parameters.label: Specified  Component
parameters.name: comp
parameters.description: The script is executed from the component specified in the   Component   parameter below.

parameters.label: Clip
parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Points to the  Clip CHOP  which will trigger the script when run in a  Clip Blender CHOP .

parameters.label: Component
parameters.name: component
parameters.description: The path that the script will be executed from if the Execute From parameter is set to  Specified  Component  .

parameters.label: Execute on Frame (First)
parameters.name: framefirst
parameters.description: Executes the script once, the first time the specified index of the clip is played in a clipblender. Even if the clip is looping in a clipblender, the script will only be executed once.

parameters.label: Execute on Frame (Loop)
parameters.name: frameloop
parameters.description: Executes the script everytime the specified index of the clip is played in a clipblender. When a clip is looping, the script will run each time through the loop.

parameters.label: Execute on Exit
parameters.name: exit
parameters.description: Executes the script when a clipblender exits the specified clip.

parameters.label: Print State
parameters.name: printstate
parameters.description: Print debug information to the textport.

parameters.label: Language
parameters.name: language
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how the  DAT  decides which script language to operate on.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs script language.

parameters.label: Node
parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses it's own script language.

parameters.label: Edit/View Extension
parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select the file extension this  DAT  should expose to external editors.

parameters.name: dat

parameters.label: From Language

parameters.description: pick extension from DATs script language.

parameters.label: Custom Extension

parameters.label: Custom Extension

parameters.label: Word Wrap

parameters.description: ⊞  - Enable Word Wrap for Node Display.

parameters.label: Input

parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs setting.

parameters.label: On

parameters.description: Turn on Word Wrap.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off

parameters.label: num_rows
parameters.description: Number of rows in this  DAT .

parameters.label: num_cols
parameters.description: Number of columns in this  DAT .

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.
